rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow (vacate/remand to dismiss as moot) and centered on Already’s forward-looking voluntary-cessation framework while rejecting the Ninth Circuit’s “acquiescence” focus. Sotomayor and/or Jackson are likely to dissent on Mesquite/“heavy burden” grounds given the conditional assurance and retained relisting discretion, with a modest chance of separate concurrences from Alito/Thomas/Gorsuch to emphasize Article III limits or skepticism of expanding voluntary-cessation exceptions.
